title: Completeness report
description: Normative annex to ADEP-WI2-CMP-v0.2 §4. W3-T01, 2026-10-25. AI draft for review. The dialect is JSON Schema draft 2020-12. The object has the eight fields in §4.2 and no ninth field. An ordering flag and an emergency_exception flag are not fields. Element state codes are the seven in the evidence-element-state fragment. This fragment does not add a verdict token.

profileReference.description: §4.2. The profile identifier from the scope declaration, including the profile version.

scopeCoverage.description: §4.2. presentClasses lists expected classes whose state is present. A redacted class is not in that list. percentage is omitted when the expected-class list is empty. That case is open item OI-3. The unit of percentage is percent.

gapList.description: §4.2. Every class in expected_not_captured, unavailable, or arrived_late. reason is omitted when none is recorded. excluded and disposed are not entries.

exclusionList.description: §4.2. Every class in excluded. reason is the producer's statement that the class was not intended to be collected.

redactionList.description: §4.2. Every class in redacted. disclosureProfileReference is the profile identifier, or a statement that no disclosure profile is declared.

disposalList.description: §4.2. Every class in disposed. disposalPolicyReference names the documented retention or disposal policy.

completenessVerdict.description: §4.3. One of the four verdicts. Omit the property for the unassigned case in open item OI-7. Omission is not a fifth verdict.

assessmentLimitations.description: §4.2. What this assessment cannot detect, including the limit NG-2 names.
